subject: Exec intro + CIO handshake — confirm 30m window for EmberTech

To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-05T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: EmberTech CIO briefing – short window?

Marcus —

Quick intro: I run partnerships for EmberTech. Our CIO, Elena Park, asked for a very short technical briefing next week to see how Redwood would fit a constrained procurement and latency budget. She prefers an executive-level handshake and a 30-minute demo focused on:
- high-level architecture and routing/failover
- predictable latency guarantees for burst workloads
- security controls (data flow, retention, KMS)

Proposed times (PDT):
- Tue 7/11, 11:00–11:30
- Wed 7/12, 09:00–09:30
- Thu 7/13, 14:00–14:30

Please loop in the appropriate sponsor/SE. We also may need a brief doc for procurement re: SOC2 and retention.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships, EmberTech
liam.oconnor@embertech.com

Subject: Re: Intro: EmberTech CIO briefing – short window?

Thanks Liam — looping in Sofia (solutions lead) and Grace (VP, Sales).

We can absolutely do a focused 30-minute briefing targeted to the CIO. Suggested plan:
- 5m intro + goals (Marcus)
- 12m live demo: routing + latency SLOs + fallback variants (Sofia)
- 8m security/compliance overview (Grace)
- 5m next steps / procurement asks

From the slots you proposed, Elena's Wed 7/12 09:00–09:30 PDT works best on our side. If you confirm, I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

For procurement: we can attach our SOC2 summary and a short note on retention controls — Sofia, can you attach the security brief and the draft agenda?

Best,
